messages:
lauren: Drafting a tiny 'goal sprint card' — one-pager + 24h peer check. should take <2 mins to write. PTAL.

lauren: TEMPLATE (copy/paste):
Team: [team]
Quarter: Q3 2026
Owner: [name]
North Star (1 line): [outcome]
Top KR (metric + target) (conf 0-10)
Top 3 actions (est effort S/M/L)
Key blocker (person/system)
One-line ask to manager (unblock/prioritize/hire)
Peer check (DM 3 peers; 3 one-line prompts):
 - Biggest customer impact?
 - What to deprioritize?
 - Anything missing?
Self-review tip (for cycle): for each KR: 1 line 'what worked' + 1 line 'evidence/link'
Micro-reply samples for peers (one-liners):
 - "Prioritize KR1; drop action 3"
 - "Clarify KR2 -> revenue"
 - "Targets look high; suggest -15% or add hire"

raj: Nice and scannable. add a one-word KR risk tag (infra/data/headcount) so managers can triage quickly.

mel: Please include 2 filled examples (SWE, PM) so people can copy-paste.

people-ops-bot: Template uploaded -> https://redwoodhq.internal/goals/sprint-card. Auto-DM template scheduled. :robot_face:

lauren: Will add examples tonight and run a 5-min manager demo tomorrow morning. thanks! :tada:
